summary: All four acceptance criteria are present, faithful and in-scope; the declared Spec Impact (MODIFY FR-01.35) is delivered in both the FR row and a new (E) criterion. No divergence found. Code-reviewer (Stage 2) may proceed.

per_criterion.AC-1: byte-for-byte block round-trip -- implemented by markdownRawHtmlBlock.ts (html_block renderer override + atom node + verbatim serialize), pinned by 8 test cases including the exact reported CTA construct.
per_criterion.AC-2: pre-existing inline fix unaffected -- inline anchor round-trip suite untouched by the diff; renderer override scoped to html_block only, html_inline never touched.
per_criterion.AC-3: distinct non-editable region -- atom:true node, contenteditable=false, data-testid=raw-html-block-chip, E2E asserts chip visibility + byte-identical saved PUT body.
per_criterion.AC-4: lossy detector -- detectHtmlLossiness uses the SAME MARKDOWN_IT_OPTIONS as the editor parser; level-0 html_block not flagged, nested/inline (beyond href-only safe-protocol anchor) still flagged, matching the AC's own wording.

out_of_scope_checks.block_content_non_editable: honoured -- atom node, no NodeView, no editable content hole
out_of_scope_checks.markdownEnvelope_split_is_verbatim_move: confirmed line-by-line identical to the deleted block; re-exported so no call site moved; recorded in the iterate spec's File split note (300-line convention)

non_blocking_observations_for_stage2: FR-01.35 row wording in spec.md is a looser capability-level summary than the precise (E) criterion -- not a divergence, spec.md documents rows are deliberately summary-level.

client/package-lock.json was excluded from the reviewer's diff file by the diff-generation command (path filter), NOT because it is unmodified -- git status confirms it IS modified alongside package.json.
The E2E blog-file warn-banner assertion flip (toBeVisible -> toBeHidden) is a disclosed, correct behaviour change (href-only anchor with https scheme is genuinely lossless), not a weakened assertion.
